1.summary: 26 canonical graph cases execute in Godot, including safe lossy and acyclic controls, strict crafted sellback equality and profit, multistep cheapest procurement, free-input and multi-input material duplication. Python independently checks every supported rejection witness against original canonical route quantities and replays its exact seed and net gain.

2.summary: A proposal safe against its own expensive offer fails when joined with a retained cheaper offer. Rejection exposes no candidate/routes and preserves the prior candidate. Multiple required inputs, recipe/offer batch counts, explicit zero and fractional unit ratios are accounted for with checked integer arithmetic.

3.summary: Finite rare-stock consumption with only an identity producer is admitted without an unlimited-cycle finding. Unknown sources/random behavior, unsupported cross-faction access and arithmetic capacity fail closed. Every graph runs again with reversed catalog arrays and preserves its decision. T06 salvage loss/no-XP/no-gold/core/starter restrictions remain enforced.
